system.description: Your suite of extraordinary powers elevates you far beyond human capabilities. You might have a versatile combination of special attributes, possibly including enhanced strength and durability that allow you to withstand immense impacts and lift incredible weights, or super-speed for rapid movement and reaction, or even more exotic abilities like flight, energy manipulation, or advanced telepathy. Superhumans are capable in a variety of different situations, though your particular specialty will determine how many ways you can benefit your group or allies during a team-up.
